title: Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah Causeway

pylon.observation: Base picked on the midpoint between the two decks in aerial imagery. The eight stay pairs run toward Shuwaikh, while the curved pylon top leans away from the stayed span.

limitations: The two mapped carriageways per link and tagged approach ramps define plan and orientation. Mapped ground roads stay native.
Deck grades and individual footing positions are visualization estimates based on standard terrain, public drawings and photos.
The pylon base was picked in an aerial reference and snapped between the mapped carriageways. The curved profile follows the photographed pylon.
